title: Finance - Bank detail
description: Every operation, filterable by person, account, category, subcategory, necessity, kind, decided-by, amount, label and date; plus the review queue of what no rule explains yet. Postgres: gold.bank_transaction_detail.

panels.title: Operations in the selection

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS operations FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail WHERE person IN ($person) AND account IN ($account) AND category IN ($category) AND subcategory IN ($subcategory) AND coalesce(necessity, 'none') IN ($necessity) AND family IN ($family) AND source IN ($source) AND abs(amount) BETWEEN ${min_amount} AND ${max_amount} AND label ILIKE '%${search}%' AND $__timeFilter(spend_date)

panels.description: Every filter above and the time range apply (on the reporting date).

panels.title: Money out

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(-sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE amount < 0), 0) AS out FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail WHERE person IN ($person) AND account IN ($account) AND category IN ($category) AND subcategory IN ($subcategory) AND coalesce(necessity, 'none') IN ($necessity) AND family IN ($family) AND source IN ($source) AND abs(amount) BETWEEN ${min_amount} AND ${max_amount} AND label ILIKE '%${search}%' AND $__timeFilter(spend_date)

panels.description: Sum of the debits in the selection. Transfers between own accounts are included here: filter them out with Category.

panels.title: Money in

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE amount > 0), 0) AS income FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail WHERE person IN ($person) AND account IN ($account) AND category IN ($category) AND subcategory IN ($subcategory) AND coalesce(necessity, 'none') IN ($necessity) AND family IN ($family) AND source IN ($source) AND abs(amount) BETWEEN ${min_amount} AND ${max_amount} AND label ILIKE '%${search}%' AND $__timeFilter(spend_date)

panels.description: Sum of the credits in the selection.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS net FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail WHERE person IN ($person) AND account IN ($account) AND category IN ($category) AND subcategory IN ($subcategory) AND coalesce(necessity, 'none') IN ($necessity) AND family IN ($family) AND source IN ($source) AND abs(amount) BETWEEN ${min_amount} AND ${max_amount} AND label ILIKE '%${search}%' AND $__timeFilter(spend_date)

panels.title: Selection by month (money out, by category)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS time, category, -sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE amount < 0) AS out FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail WHERE person IN ($person) AND account IN ($account) AND category IN ($category) AND subcategory IN ($subcategory) AND coalesce(necessity, 'none') IN ($necessity) AND family IN ($family) AND source IN ($source) AND abs(amount) BETWEEN ${min_amount} AND ${max_amount} AND label ILIKE '%${search}%' AND $__timeFilter(spend_date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Follows the filters. For 'all car operations', pick Category = car.

panels.title: Operations (every line of the selection)

targets.rawSql: SELECT spend_date AS date, account, person, amount, label, category, subcategory, necessity, family, source, rule_id, txn_id FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail WHERE person IN ($person) AND account IN ($account) AND category IN ($category) AND subcategory IN ($subcategory) AND coalesce(necessity, 'none') IN ($necessity) AND family IN ($family) AND source IN ($source) AND abs(amount) BETWEEN ${min_amount} AND ${max_amount} AND label ILIKE '%${search}%' AND $__timeFilter(spend_date) ORDER BY spend_date DESC, abs(amount) DESC

panels.description: Click a column header to sort, or use the filters above. txn_id is what overrides.csv needs to fix one operation.

panels.title: Review queue: what no rule explains yet (largest first)

targets.rawSql: SELECT spend_date AS date, account, person, amount, label, family, category, subcategory, txn_id FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail WHERE needs_review ORDER BY abs(amount) DESC

panels.description: Not affected by the filters. Fix it once for all similar operations with a rule in rules.yaml (match on the label), or for this one operation with a line in overrides.csv (use txn_id); then `make sync-bank`.

panels.title: Top labels not yet covered by a rule

targets.rawSql: SELECT label, count(*) AS operations, sum(amount) AS amount FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail WHERE needs_review AND amount < 0 GROUP BY label ORDER BY sum(amount) LIMIT 30

panels.description: Grouped by cleaned label: a good rule candidate has many operations or a large amount.

panels.title: How operations were classified

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, count(*) AS operations FROM gold.bank_transaction_detail GROUP BY source ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: rule, override, transfer_pair (own-account transfers) or default (nothing matched).
